# Business Travel Policy

Domestic travel per diem is $60/day for meals not otherwise covered by a client or conference.
International travel per diem is $85/day.

Flights over 6 hours may be booked in premium economy with manager approval; otherwise economy
class is standard. Travel must be booked through the corporate travel portal (Egencia) at least 7
days in advance where possible to secure negotiated rates.

Rental cars require a mid-size or smaller vehicle unless transporting equipment.

Submit all travel expenses within 14 days of return via Expensify, referencing the trip's
approval ticket number.
